s: Bellring Laurel
STR +10, MAG +10, Afterglow gain +15%. Valka wore it for nine years. It still smells faintly of victory and oil.
Sand Hound
Bred under the east stand. They have only ever known sand, crowds and the bell, and they love all three.
Kell the Net
Throws a net, then apologizes. The older brother. Says the net does most of the work.
Kell the Fist
Does not throw a net. Does not apologize. The younger brother.
A war-boar who has eaten three gates and, allegedly, a herald. The herald disputes this.
Shipped from the Sunscar in padded crates marked FRAGILE. The crates were for the handlers.
Bellring Squire
Squires who failed the Dawnguard trials fight here instead. The crowd is kinder than the Lord-Commander.
Sereno the Swift
Fastest blade in the Heartland, slowest to pay his tab. He will steal your purse mid-bout and return it after, with a bow.
The Iron Bull
Cast in the bell foundries from a cracked bell and a bad idea. Hit it right and it still rings.
Mire Lurker
Dredged from the Fens at tremendous personal risk. Ottavio paid the dredgers in tickets.
Mask of Dawn
She prays before every bout and after every win. She has prayed a lot.
Mask of Dusk
He curses before every bout. Nobody has ever heard what he says. Nobody wants to.
The Scythe Matron
Mother of a thousand, mercy for none. The Bellring keeps her eggs in a vault. Nobody volunteers for vault duty.
Storm Kite
They roost in the bell tower and ride its echoes. When the bell rings, they come down to see who rang it.
Phalanx Guard
Three shields, one wall, no gaps. They have drilled together for twenty years and still argue about who stands left.
Valka the Undefeated
Forty-one bouts, forty-one wins. A Skylancer from the north who came to Aurenne for the Dawnguard and stayed for the crowd.
Grizzlemaw thunders across the sand!
Grizzlemaw squeals and tosses its head. The crowd loves it.
Grizzlemaw paws the sand and lowers its tusks... Guard!
The Iron Bull brings its whole weight down — BONG.
Rivets groan. The Iron Bull braces, plates grinding shut.
The Iron Bull rears up on its hind legs, iron screaming... Guard!
The Matron sweeps both scythes through the whole ring!
The Matron shrieks. Her wings blur.
The Scythe Matron raises both scythes high... Guard!
Sunsteel Lance! The whole ring rings like a struck bell.
"Now it is a fight." Valka throws off her cape.
Valka plants her feet and draws the lance back to her ear. Guard!
Aurenne's colosseum, east of the bell foundries. Four cups, one champion, and a crowd that bets on everything.
